method: Editorial snapshot from publisher pages and official releases; not Marketaux or MT5

stories.title: Oil and regional risk lead the weekend watchlist
stories.summary: Reuters reports that higher oil supported Saudi equities on Sunday while regional tensions weighed on other markets.
stories.relevance: Watch energy inflation and risk sentiment at the next open; gold's response is not predetermined.
stories.period: Sunday developments; oil settlement referenced is Friday

stories.title: Lagarde points to tighter financing as a brake on inflation
stories.summary: Reuters reports that Lagarde said the bond selloff increases borrowing costs and should curb growth and inflation.
stories.relevance: Compare European rate expectations with US yields and the dollar before attributing a gold move.

stories.title: Gold faces weekly pressure as traders assess the Fed path
stories.summary: Reuters reported gold was heading for a weekly loss on Friday amid uncertainty about further US rate increases.
stories.relevance: Carry the rates question into the next session; Friday's report is not a current quote.

stories.title: Bailey says wider energy-price effects remain limited so far
stories.summary: Reuters reports that the Bank of England governor sees limited evidence of broader inflation spillovers but says conclusions are premature.
stories.relevance: Track sterling, gilt yields and policy expectations through the London handover.

stories.title: China's official gold purchases strengthen in September
stories.summary: World Gold Council reports a 23-tonne September addition by the PBoC, bringing reported third-quarter buying to 63 tonnes.
stories.relevance: This is a medium-term demand input, not evidence of buying at the next session open.
stories.verification: Industry research; cites official reserve data

stories.title: September US CPI rises 0.6% monthly and 3.7% annually
stories.summary: The BLS release records headline CPI at 0.6% month over month and 3.7% year over year; core CPI rose 0.3% monthly.
stories.relevance: Separate this released data from market rate expectations and the next scheduled inflation report.

stories.title: Bitcoin steadies after a four-week low
stories.summary: Barron's reports bitcoin stabilized after US inflation and activity data strengthened expectations of further rate increases.
stories.relevance: Review rates and risk appetite together; do not assume BTC and gold must respond alike.
stories.verification: Publisher reporting; access may require subscription

stories.title: Softer dollar supports major cryptocurrencies in Friday coverage
stories.summary: Dow Jones coverage in the WSJ describes support from a softer dollar while spot demand remains a concern.
stories.relevance: Use synchronized BTC and DXY observations when checking the reported relationship.
stories.verification: Publisher reporting; access may require subscription
